EBUS Procedure Report
Procedure date: 2026-03-31

Patient: 55-year-old female. Indication: mediastinal staging of known lung cancer. History: prior bronchoscopy in 2024 with EBUS sampling of station 4R was nondiagnostic.

ASA class II. General anesthesia via a 7.5 mm endotracheal tube.

Linear EBUS-TBNA was performed as planned and completed.

Linear EBUS was performed for targeted nodal diagnosis using a targeted sampling strategy. Station 7 was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 7: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 22-gauge needle, 2 passes. ROSE of station 7: non-necrotizing granulomas, adequate. Specimen A: station 7 aspirates (cytology). Station 10R was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 10R measured 13 mm in short axis. Station 10R: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 22-gauge needle, two passes. ROSE of station 10R: blood only, inadequate. Specimen B: station 10R aspirates (cytology). Station 2L was visualized on EBUS but not sampled because an intervening vessel prevented a safe needle path. Station 11Ri was visualized on EBUS but not sampled because it appeared benign on ultrasound.

No immediate complications.

Procedure duration: 56 minutes. The patient was discharged home after recovery.

Indication:
Patient: 73-year-old male, never smoker. Indication: tissue diagnosis of a peripheral lung lesion. History: prior bronchoscopy in 2023 with EBUS sampling of station 7 was nondiagnostic.

Robotic Bronchoscopy Procedure Report
Procedure date: 2026-02-21

**Indication:** Indication: tissue diagnosis of a peripheral lung lesion and mediastinal staging.

**Anesthesia:** ASA class III. General anesthesia via an 8.5 mm endotracheal tube.

**Procedures:** Robotic-assisted bronchoscopy was performed as planned and completed. Linear EBUS-TBNA was performed as planned and completed.

## Robotic navigation and sampling
Target 1 was a 22 mm cavitary lesion in the superior segment (LB6) of the left lower lobe. A bronchus sign was present. It was FDG-avid (SUVmax 11.1). Target 1 was the prespecified biopsy target. The robotic catheter was navigated to target 1, and the target was reached and sampled. Fixed cone-beam CT confirmed the needle tip within the lesion before sampling (tool-in-lesion). Fluoroscopy was used during sampling. Pass 1: 22-gauge needle aspiration of target 1. Pass 2: 22-gauge needle aspiration of target 1. Pass 3: 22-gauge needle aspiration of target 1. Pass 4: 22-gauge needle aspiration of target 1. Transbronchial forceps biopsies were obtained (3 passes). Bronchial brushings were obtained (2 passes). Specimen A: needle aspirates and brushings from target 1 (cytology). Specimen B: forceps biopsies from target 1 (histology).

## Linear EBUS
Linear EBUS was performed for targeted nodal diagnosis using a targeted sampling strategy. Station 2L was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 2L measured 14 mm in short axis. Station 2L: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 22-gauge needle, five passes. ROSE of station 2L: non-necrotizing granulomas, adequate. Station 7 was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 7: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 22-gauge needle, two passes. ROSE of station 7: blood only, inadequate. Specimen C: station 7 aspirates (cytology). Station 10R was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 10R measured 13 mm in short axis. Station 10R: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 22-gauge needle, three passes. ROSE of station 10R: blood only, inadequate. Specimen D: station 10R aspirates (cytology).

**Complications:** No immediate complications.

**Disposition:** Procedure duration: 85 minutes.

INDICATION
Patient: 54-year-old male, former smoker (25 pack-years). Indication: tissue diagnosis of a peripheral lung lesion.

ANESTHESIA
Moderate sedation was used with a natural airway.

PROCEDURES
Robotic-assisted bronchoscopy was performed as planned and completed.

ROBOTIC NAVIGATION AND SAMPLING
The Galaxy robotic platform was used for navigation. Target 1 was a solid lesion in the apical segment (RB1) of the right upper lobe. There was no bronchus sign. Target 1 was the prespecified biopsy target. The first navigation attempt to target 1 did not reach the target because registration divergence could not be corrected. On the second attempt, the robotic catheter was navigated to target 1, and the target was reached and sampled. Radial EBUS showed a concentric view, confirming tool-in-lesion. Transbronchial forceps biopsies were obtained (six passes). Specimen A: forceps biopsies from target 1 (histology).

COMPLICATIONS
No immediate complications.
